official_data_source.source_name: Lean 4 finite-model theorem reconstruction proof corpus
official_data_source.source_authority: Lean project and Logion formal proof corpus steward

target_variable.name: formal_theorem_reconstruction_verdict_replay
target_variable.extraction_rule: Hold back observed_verdict, passed, lean_theorem_ref until the formal proof route materializes from proofs/finite_model_checks/OC133_FINITE_MODEL_INPUTS.json.
target_variable.target_statement: Reconstruct held-out theorem-case ACCEPT/REJECT verdicts from pre-execution finite-model facts and bind each accepted row to theorem ID, proof sheet, Lean ref, and executable snapshot.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Join finite-model input rows to executed proof-corpus rows by case_id; the pre-execution expected verdict is the formal prediction and the executed finite/Lean snapshot supplies the observed verdict.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: predict ACCEPT for every theorem_case row regardless of finite model facts
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model_residual == 0 and comparator_residual > model_residual with all formal negative controls rejected

uncertainty_requirement.rule: No empirical uncertainty interval is claimed; exact proof-check equality is required.

residual_requirement.formula: sum(1 if preregistered_formal_verdict != executed_formal_verdict else 0) over locked formal rows
residual_requirement.definition: 0/1 mismatch between pre-execution expected verdict and executed observed verdict, aggregated by sum over valid theorem_case rows.
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_residual == 0 and comparator_residual > model_residual with all formal negative controls rejected

negative_control_requirement.rule: comparator_residual > model_residual on every valid REJECT row aggregate
negative_control_requirement.description: Rows whose pre-execution verdict is REJECT must reject the accept-all comparator while passing the exact formal replay.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: any observed verdict or passed flag appears in the pre-execution input corpus; any input/output model hash, Lean ref, theorem ID, proof sheet, or passed flag is unbound; Lean build certificate does not bind the current Lean source; model residual is nonzero or the accept-all comparator is not rejected; formal support is counted as empirical grand-science evidence
trigger_predicates: any observed verdict or passed flag appears in the pre-execution input corpus
any input/output model hash, Lean ref, theorem ID, proof sheet, or passed flag is unbound
Lean build certificate does not bind the current Lean source
model residual is nonzero or the accept-all comparator is not rejected
formal support is counted as empirical grand-science evidence

current_evidence.reason: Existing Lean/finite/proof artifacts are present as candidate formal-route material, but this coverage spec does not certify exact coverage evidence. The mathematics executor replay must be synchronized and a formal coverage-scope review must pass before this row can claim exact evidence.

source_proof_corpus.scope_boundary: Existing rows can support formal theorem-case reconstruction checks only. They do not assert theorem-prover superiority, empirical numeric prediction, or broad modern-science coverage.
